nativeRange: Eastern Himalayas and the mountains of southwestern China
biome: Cool temperate forest with bamboo understory
facts: Red pandas are the only living members of the family Ailuridae.
Bamboo makes up about 95 percent of their wild diet, supplemented by fruit and small prey.
They use a modified wrist bone like a thumb to grasp bamboo stems.
Red pandas are solitary outside breeding, but a mother accompanies her cubs for about a year.
